title: Term width for parity
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $\varphi$ be a DNF formula on $n$ sign coordinates, and suppose its Boolean function equals the parity function on all $n$ coordinates. Every term $T$ in $\varphi$ has width $n$.
hypotheses_covered: The formula's Boolean function equals parity on all $n$ coordinates
